4. What is the geometric shape the linear regression algorithm aims
   to create when there are two input features?
  A) A straight line
   B) A plane
   C) A hyperplane
  D) A cluster centroid
   Answer: B
   Refer to Lecture 27: Fundamentals of Machine Learning-II Slide
   6
